newsitem.title: UK: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.
newsitem.headline: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.

text.p: A total 79,500 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 44.709 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at Wednesday's European Union (EU) tender, the U.K. Intervention Board said.
Out of this, traders in France received 36,500 tonnes, in Germany 17,500, in Belgium 17,000 and in the U.K. 8,500 tonnes, it added.
Earlier on Wednesday, London traders had expected the subsidy for the current season whites campaign to be 44.709 Ecus per 100 kilos, the exact amount awarded.

Traders had also forecast the total authorised sugar tonnage export awards to be in a wide range between 40,000 and 100,000 tonnes versus 129,500 tonnes last week when the restitution was 44.837 Ecus.
